qualifications: Statistics describe selected active-plume casts on channel axes, not mapped whole-current depth or thickness profiles.
Winter and summer source boundary thresholds differ; these are not a common-operator annual range.
Casts without significant active flow were omitted. Summer quiescence does not establish zero thickness.
Bottom layers below approximately 15 m were undetectable with these LADCP observations.
Layer records share casts. Do not sum their cast counts or independently sampled extrema.
Plume thickness differs from water depth, equilibration depth, core depth and isohaline water-mass extent.
The table reports means; individual cast weights and per-cast geometry have not been reconstructed.
Bathymetric channel width is not plume width. No stored-volume multiplication is supported.
